|game_text=Deploys -1 to [Episode I] locations. If you just lost Force from an opponent's Effect, may ▲ an [Episode I] Interrupt (except [[Control]]), or place a card from hand under [[Credits Will Do Fine]]. May not be [[Disarmed]]. Immune to [[You Are Beaten]], and attrition.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Master Qui-Gon (V) (AI) (Virtual Block 5)]]; it is the current text. The image here is the Players Committee AI card image ([[:File:VB5-L-masterquigonai-pre.gif]], marked E), which prints this text; the original text is shown on [[Master Qui-Gon (V) (AI) (Virtual Block 5)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Master Qui-Gon (V) (AI) (Virtual Block 5)]]): the AI printing has the text of the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009; the sheet has no AI slip, only slip [[:File:VB5-45-Master_Qui_Gon.png]] of the base card #45): “Deploys -1 to [Episode I] locations. If you just lost Force from an opponent's Effect, may ▲ an [Episode I] Interrupt (except Control), or place a card from hand under Credits Will Do Fine. Immune to Disarmed, You Are Beaten, and attrition.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 5, slip 45AI. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref> The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) lists the AI printing separately with this text (the base printing already had its errata there)<ref name="cl-1250_44ai-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): “May not be Disarmed.” replaces “Disarmed,” in the immunity list: “Deploys -1 to [Episode I] locations. If you just lost Force from an opponent's Effect, may ▲ an [Episode I] Interrupt (except Control), or place a card from hand under Credits Will Do Fine. May not be Disarmed. Immune to You Are Beaten, and attrition.” Printed in the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) (one Master Qui-Gon (V) slip, marked E)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=12, page 12. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=12 Internet Archive]</ref>. The Players Committee AI card image ([[:File:VB5-L-masterquigonai-pre.gif]], marked E) prints the same text without the comma after “You Are Beaten” (punctuation only, not a separate version).
